translations.web: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”
translations.bsb: Rather, as it is written: “No eye has seen, no ear has heard, no heart has imagined, what God has prepared for those who love Him.”
translations.kjv: But as it is written, Eye hath ➔ not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.
translations.asv: but as it is written, Things which eye saw not, and ear heard not, And which entered not into the heart of man, Whatsoever things God prepared for them that love him.
